The reaction yield of the infinitely thick target was obtained in several runs at E/d = 5 to 30 KeV with energy step at 0.5 KeV at E/d =5 to 10 KeV and 1.0 KeV at E/d = 10 to 30 KeV. The energy step correspond to about 50 and 100 atomic layers near the surface. 2. The normalization led to a value for the stoichiometric ratio. 3. The resulting cross section is the weighted average of several runs.
